Key constraints / asks: fragments, bullets —
- Must support fully air-gapped install: image + model weights delivered on media, installable by customer ops.
- KMS/HSM integration mandatory for key escrow; customer runs enterprise HSM appliances (Luna).
- Audit logs retained for 7+ years, immutable export for federal audits.
- SAML SSO for admin plane, local AD/LDAP for node auth.
- No telemetry offboarded without explicit change control.
- Formal supply-chain attestation (SBOM + signed images) requested by head of procurement.

POC ask: 30-day on-prem pilot in isolated lab (customer will provide lab network + L1 guard). Evaluate: latency under 150ms for short-chat queries at 16 concurrent users; batch throughput for embeddings 200 qps baseline. Acceptance = functional parity w/ hosted API for prompt routing + verified fallbacks.

Commercial: leaning enterprise reserved pricing but wants fixed cost for accreditations and change-window support. Estimated ARR range discussed. Procurement says decision tied to Program Office timeline (FY27).
